holds: Expectations are reviewable-draft adjudications over non-canonical bases and assert no conformance, installability or standards alignment.

cases.input: A valuation asserts amount 1000000 EUR on 2026-06-30 with no subjectKind.
cases.expect: Rejected. subjectKind is mandatory.

cases.input: A valuation asserts subjectKind "portfolio".
cases.expect: Rejected. subjectKind is restricted to investee, instrument, holding, investment-participation, investment-carrying-amount.

cases.input: An investee valuation of X on 2026-06-30 is read as the investment-carrying-amount of INV-1 and posted to the ledger.
cases.expect: Rejected. The five subject kinds are never interchangeable; a carrying-amount assertion requires its own valuation with accounting basis.

cases.input: A valuation with subjectKind "instrument" names instrument N and subjectVersionRef v1, basis date 2026-06-30.
cases.expect: Accepted and resolvable only against v1.

cases.input: The 2026-06-30 valuation of note N v1 is reused as the valuation of N v2 after conversion on 2026-08-15.
cases.expect: Rejected. A valuation is never resolvable across a version boundary; v2 requires its own assertion.

cases.input: A valuation with subjectKind "holding" names position H-1 without its effective interval, and H-1 was derecognized on 2026-08-15.
cases.expect: Rejected. A holding valuation requires positionRef plus the effective interval in force at the basis date.

cases.input: For investee X, basis date 2026-06-30: V-A income approach EUR, knowledge time 2026-07-10T09:00Z; V-B market approach USD, knowledge time 2026-07-12T09:00Z.
cases.expect: Both persist as independently resolvable assertions with their own method, basis, inputs, model version, uncertainty, evidence digest and knowledge time. Neither supersedes the other and neither sets any voting, ownership or control value.

cases.input: V-B is selected over V-A solely because its knowledge time is later, and V-A is marked superseded.
cases.expect: Rejected. Recency alone never reconciles same-date divergence; supersession requires an explicit review act.

cases.input: A review on 2026-09-01 supersedes V-A, recording actor, authority, basis and knowledge time.
cases.expect: Accepted. V-A, its inputs, evidence, uncertainty and provenance remain resolvable at their original knowledge time.

cases.input: Supersession removes V-A's record, inputs or evidence digest, or renders it unresolvable.
cases.expect: Rejected. Supersession never deletes or overwrites the superseded assertion.

cases.input: V-B's USD amount is replaced by its EUR equivalent with no rate source, type, date, direction or rounding retained.
cases.expect: Rejected. Conversion preserves the original amount and full rate provenance.

cases.input: A completed valuation review is cited as the basis for a voting, ownership, control or consolidation conclusion about X.
cases.expect: Rejected. A valuation review may supersede a value and never confers, alters or evidences a right, vote, control relation or consolidation treatment.
cases.violates: Value never establishes voting, control or consolidation
invariantRefs: Value never establishes voting, control or consolidation

cases.input: The most recent investee valuation of X is submitted as the evidence basis for a control assertion in WM-ORG-012.
cases.expect: Rejected. Control basis and scope derive only from recognized governance and effective-ownership facts.
cases.violates: Latest investee valuation is not evidence of voting power or control
invariantRefs: Latest investee valuation is not evidence of voting power or control

cases.input: Financial Instrument or Investment emits an ownership percentage or voting-power figure for holder I in investee X.
cases.expect: Rejected. Both candidates exclude the percentage and voting-power computation; mastership is unadjudicated and no denominator rule is specified in this dossier.
cases.violates: Derived rights facts are mastered outside both candidates
invariantRefs: Derived rights facts are mastered outside both candidates

cases.input: An as-converted figure including I's unexercised conversion right is used as I's current ownership percentage or vote count.
cases.expect: Rejected. Pre-conversion the note holder has zero current votes and zero current ownership percentage; contingent rights never enter a current denominator.
cases.violates: Contingent rights excluded from current denominators
invariantRefs: Contingent rights excluded from current denominators

cases.input: Conversion reuses position identity H-1 for the successor equity holding, rewriting its quantity, cost lineage and restrictions.
cases.expect: Rejected. Conversion derecognizes the predecessor and creates a distinct successor position with explicit lineage; the predecessor is never overwritten.

cases.input: A WM-ECO-016 posting for an acquisition is created with no reference to an economic event.
cases.expect: Rejected. A posting is the accounting representation of an event and never substitutes for the event's identity.
cases.violates: Event, settlement, position change and posting remain distinct
invariantRefs: Event, settlement, position change and posting remain distinct

cases.input: Trade, settlement, availability and position change for one acquisition are recorded as a single timestamped state.
cases.expect: Rejected. Trade, settlement, availability, position change and posting are distinct states or events with distinct times.
cases.violates: Distinct transaction, settlement and posting objects
invariantRefs: Distinct transaction, settlement and posting objects

cases.input: A posted entry is edited to correct an amount.
cases.expect: Rejected. Posted entries are immutable; correction is by linked reversal or successor and the original remains resolvable.
cases.violates: Posted entries are immutable; corrections append
invariantRefs: Posted entries are immutable; corrections append

cases.input: Conversion event E-1 on 2026-08-15 emits closing and opening lines within one ledger, currency, scope and tolerance, referencing E-1 and the affected lots.
cases.expect: Accepted. The posting set balances within the WM-ECO-016 boundary and carries explicit event and lot lineage.

cases.input: InvestmentTransaction is profiled onto a named canonical trade or settlement event master.
cases.expect: Rejected. No trade/settlement or corporate-action master is allocated in this dossier; the transaction leg is unbound and only the WM-ECO-016 posting leg is bound.

cases.input: contentDigest is computed over an implementation-specific serialization, or with an unnamed algorithm.
cases.expect: Rejected. The digest is sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of the object's required fields, excluding contentDigest, derived fields and cache fields, in the form sha256:<lowercase-hex>.

cases.input: Two implementations digest the same InstrumentVersion required-field set with reordered JSON keys.
cases.expect: Identical digests.

cases.input: An InstrumentVersion or participation revision records effectiveFrom only, with no recordedAt or knowledgeTime.
cases.expect: Rejected. Effective, record and knowledge times are separately required and never substituted.

cases.input: An effectiveFrom declared with date precision is stored as a timezone-bearing instant and reported as such.
cases.expect: Rejected. Declared date-only precision is preserved and never widened or timezone-shifted.

cases.input: Any EM-FIN-06 artifact populates a modelId, registryId, catalogueId or runtimeId for Financial Instrument, Investment or the profile.
cases.expect: Rejected. All identifier fields are null and allocationState is unassigned for every EM-FIN-06 artifact.
cases.violates: Allocate no catalogue, model or runtime identifier
invariantRefs: Allocate no catalogue, model or runtime identifier

cases.input: An EM-FIN-06 artifact asserts canonical completeness, installability, publication readiness or crosswalk conformance to FIBO, ISO 20022, IFRS 9 or 13, IAS 32 or XBRL.
cases.expect: Rejected. All bases are reviewable drafts with publishableCanonical false; crosswalks, release pins and licences are unverified.

cases.input: An artifact holds that independent Grok review or the frozen audit remains pending.
cases.expect: Rejected. Dual study and the single frozen audit are complete; only absence of external third-party review of the bases remains an open hold.

cases.input: Note N v1 held by I in investee X as INV-1 with positions H-1a and H-1b carrying a contingent conversion right; basis date 2026-06-30 valuations V-A (income, EUR) and V-B (market, USD) of X; conversion event E-1 on 2026-08-15 converting H-1a to H-2 against v2.
cases.expect: I holds zero current votes and zero current ownership percentage pre-conversion; V-A and V-B both persist and set no rights; E-1 derecognizes H-1a, creates H-2 with lineage and linked balanced postings; H-1b remains against v1; N's state remains effective; INV-1 continues with a new participation revision; V-A and V-B remain resolvable at their original knowledge times; no identifier is allocated and no publishability is claimed.
